name: Squidward Window
look: A still from SpongeBob SquarePants. Squidward, seen from behind in his brown shirt, stands in his dim house looking out a round window through purple blinds. Outside, SpongeBob and Patrick jump around happily with their arms in the air.
use: Squidward is someone stuck inside or left out, watching others enjoy something he can't or won't join. SpongeBob and Patrick are the people having fun, often labeled as friends, kids on vacation, or anyone without responsibilities.
slots: the one watching from inside (Squidward, left)
the ones having fun outside (SpongeBob and Patrick, right)
examples: The neighborhood kids on summer break
describe: squidward looking out his window at spongebob and patrick
grumpy squid peeking through the blinds at friends playing outside
spongebob and patrick jumping around while squidward watches from inside
cartoon guy stuck at home staring at people having fun
me watching everyone else enjoy their day spongebob
origin: A still from the animated series SpongeBob SquarePants.
